## Objective
- Finish the existing “LAST STAND — Deadwater County” survival game and make it fully playable.

## Requirements
- Build the game without asking clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them on completion.
- Save small JPEG screenshots at no more than 1280px wide and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Implement scavenging, inventory and crafting, a campfire objective, and hostile enemies in the existing game UI.
- Assume the win condition is to craft and place a campfire at Miller’s Crossing, light it, and survive until dawn.

## Work State
### Completed
- Implemented canvas-rendered terrain, buildings, caches, trees, rocks, zombies, survivor movement, and minimap in `index.html`.
- Added keyboard and touch controls, melee combat, scavenging, inventory, item use, crafting, flashlight, survival meters, and win/lose screens.
- JavaScript syntax check passed; generated and inspected the latest 1280×720 JPEG screenshot at `/tmp/opencode/last-stand.jpg`.

### Active
- Verify playable interactions and resolve any runtime issues found.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Test movement, scavenging, inventory, crafting, combat, and the campfire win/lose loop in a browser.
2. Fix any issues found and rerun checks; capture and inspect a fresh screenshot only if visual changes are made.
3. Briefly summarize the implemented game and assumptions.

## Relevant Files
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/index.html`: game UI and implementation.
- `/tmp/opencode/last-stand.jpg`: latest inspected screenshot.

## Important Context
- Changes to `index.html` are uncommitted.
- Controls: WASD/arrows move, Shift sprint, E interact/search, Space melee, I inventory, M map, 1–4 use items, F flashlight; touch controls are also present.
